svg.title: Water piles against a locked gate leaf across the sole low drainage cut.
svg.desc: The decorative boundary has open side gaps on raised embankments, but its locked access leaf plugs the only low diversion and forces rising water back towards the lane. Ila tests the gate, Babul-da steadies his cycle van and Cecil records the contradiction between security and drainage.
svg.text: Page 49, panel 1 · Low wide shot along the sealed New Development gate
